title: Clean Your Room
description: Click or drag items to the trash to clean your messy room before time runs out!
how_to_play:
1. Press Play to start.
2. Click or drag clutter items into the trash.
3. Each item scores points.
4. Try to clean as much as you can before time ends.

Tips:
- Drag larger items first.
- Quick clicks on nearby items help boost score.
